parameters.content:
## CV Keyword Optimizer

1. User provides Google Docs CV link + JD
2. Copies original doc (preserves formatting)
3. AI generates find/replace pairs for experience bullets
4. Applies replacements via Docs API
5. Output: new Google Doc link

parameters.formDescription: Paste your Google Docs CV link and the job description.

values.placeholder: Paste the full job description here...

parameters.functionCode:
const items = $input.all();
return items.map(item => ({ json: { status: 'error', message: '❌ Failed: ' + (item.json.error || 'Unknown error'), suggestion: 'Check GROQ_API_KEY and Google Docs link.' } }));
